annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1188 amending Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards environmental performance and emission requirements, automated valet parking, electric safety and advanced driver distraction warning requirements
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1188 amending Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards environmental performance and emission requirements, automated valet parking, electric safety and advanced driver distraction warning requirements
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission delegated regulation amending Annex II of the vehicle type-approval Regulation 2018/858. It adds Euro 7 emission requirements, driver control assistance systems (UN R171) and automated valet parking to the EU whole-vehicle type-approval lists. It also sets lead times for small-series and special-purpose vehicles and updates the equivalent UN Regulations table.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds UN Regulation 171 driver control assistance systems and automated valet parking (Implementing Reg. 2022/1426) to Annex II type-approval list
Adds Euro 7 emission items (GA1–GA18) referencing Regulation 2024/1257 and Implementing Regulations 2025/1706 and 2025/1707
Extends advanced driver distraction warning dates for small-series and special-purpose vehicles to 7 July 2026 (type-approval) and 7 July 2028 (registration)
Gives lead time and test waivers under UN Regulation 100 for small-series and wheelchair-accessible vehicles
Updates the table of equivalent UN Regulations in Part II
